title: Teaching Software Engineering with LLM and MCP Integration: From Classroom to Industry Practice
title_zh: 融合 LLM 与 MCP 的软件工程教学：从课堂到产业实践
abstract_en: The rapid integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) into industrial software engineering has created a pressing need to update software engineering education to align with emerging technologies and evolving industry demands. This study investigates an innovative approach that integrates LLMs and MCP into a collaborative teaching model for software engineering education, aiming to build a practical learning framework closely connected to real-world engineering practices. By embedding LLM and MCP driven tools into daily teaching, code assistance, and engineering simulations, the model effectively bridges the gap between traditional instruction and industrial workflows. This integration enhances students' programming competence, practical problem-solving abilities, and proficiency in using intelligent engineering tools. Furthermore, through partnerships with industry internships, students can apply these technologies in real-world settings, further strengthening the connection between academic preparation and professional practice. Overall, this research offers a practical pathway for reforming and innovating software engineering education in the era of artificial intelligence.
abstract_zh: 随着 Large Language Models (LLMs) 与 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 快速进入工业软件工程流程，软件工程教育亟需更新，以适应新兴技术与产业需求。本文探索一种将 LLMs 与 MCP 融入软件工程协同教学的创新模式，目标是构建更贴近真实工程实践的学习框架。该模式将 LLM 与 MCP 驱动工具嵌入日常教学、代码辅助与工程仿真中，从而弥合传统课堂教学与工业工作流之间的差距。研究认为，这种集成能够提升学生的编程能力、实践问题解决能力，以及使用智能工程工具的熟练度。同时，通过与企业实习合作，学生可在真实场景中应用相关技术，进一步强化学术培养与职业实践之间的连接。总体而言，本文为 AI 时代的软件工程教育改革提供了一条实践路径。
key_points_zh: 提出将 LLMs 与 MCP 集成到软件工程课程中的协同教学模式，强调课堂学习与真实产业工作流对齐。
通过在日常教学、代码辅助和工程仿真中嵌入智能工具，帮助学生理解并使用现代 AI 驱动的软件开发流程。
该教学框架旨在提升学生的编程能力、工程实践能力、问题解决能力和智能工具使用能力。
结合企业实习与产业合作，让学生在真实软件工程场景中应用 LLM 与 MCP 技术。
论文定位于 AI 时代软件工程教育改革，为高校课程设计与产教融合提供实践参考。

llm_assessment.comment: Primarily an education-oriented integration discussion with limited architectural, governance, or self-improving agent-platform contribution.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该论文主要是面向教育场景的集成讨论，对智能体平台架构、治理或自我改进的贡献有限。
